remarks: Located just 1 mile from Compo Beach, 32 Valley Road is a serene and secluded oasis in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. This beautifully restored 1900 Colonial farmhouse seamlessly blends historic charm with modern upgrades, including a new HVAC system with central AC, city water and sewer. The sun drenched 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home spans 1500 square feet on a .79 acre lot. A separate 242 square foot heated office or playroom features cathedral ceilings and woodland views. The chef's kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, cathedral ceiling and a reverse osmosis water filtration system while steps away French doors in the dining room allow natural light to flood in. The front to back family room boasts new hardwood floors and the living room offers floor-to-ceiling bookshelves and a wood-burning fireplace. The main level primary ensuite features a vaulted ceiling, abundant windows, and direct access to the back patio. The upper level includes two charming bedrooms and a full bathroom. This unique property presents a rare opportunity to own a piece of history with today's conveniences already in place. Minutes from town, Metro North, I-95, award-winning restaurants, and Westport's top-rated schools, 32 Valley Road is perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat or a home ideal for entertaining.
